svg.title: Smart-Contract Integrated State Machine (Hybrid Pattern: Contract → Order Flow)

g.text: Order created ONLY when contract committed
Contract manages payment conditions before order creation
All risks mitigated, safe to create order
Order created when all contract conditions are met
Order processes payment capture and fulfillment
Handling failures and cancellations at any stage
Clean cancellation with full audit trail
• committed - Order created, linked to contract
• OK - Order completed, ready for fulfillment
OLD: Order exists from "Place Order" click
NEW: Order exists only when contract committed
Order created ONLY when all conditions met
→ No orphan orders for failed payments
All preconditions (payment, fraud, stock) tracked in contract
Webhook finds contract by provider order ID
Works with Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Unzer, Klarna, Amazon Pay, Square
→ Maps provider states to contract states
All state transitions triggered by events
1. Finds contract by provider order ID
